concept_gloss.applicability: Sözün zihinde bulunduğu ama henüz sesle açıklanmadığı bağlamlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İçte bulunma ve açıklanmama sınırını korur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin zihninde veya içinde tasarladığı, henüz sesle dışa vurmadığı söz veya anlamdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözün içte tasarlanmış fakat açığa vurulmamış olmasıdır.
Söz, kişinin içinde bulunur ve sesli ifadeye dönüşmeden önceki aşamadadır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin içinde tutup açıklamadığı söz bağlamında doğal aktarım sağlar.

error_profile.preserves: İçte tutulan ve açıklanmayan sözü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içte tasarlanan ve açığa vurulmamış sözdür; sesli ifade veya mezhep inancı değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dışa vurulmadan önce zihinde tasarlanan veya kişinin içinde tuttuğu sözü anlatır. Geçici çerçeve bu iç söz anlamını doğru verir ve sesli söyleme ile inanç anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım içte söz bulunduğunu belirten kalıpla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular iç düşünce, sır, zihinde söz, susma ve kök içi sesli söyleme açısından tarandı; aşama farkını gösterenler yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aşama farkı belirleyicidir: bu dal iç tasarımda kalır, komşu sesli ifadeye dönüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sözün içte kalmış ve açığa çıkmamış aşamasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sözün sesle dışa vurulmuş biçimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de söz veya anlam içeriğiyle ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda zihinsel tekrar veya işleme eylemi vardır; bu dalda içte duran sözün durumu merkezdir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal henüz açığa vurulmamış sözün içte bulunmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir sözü zihinde dolaştırma, tekrarlama veya alıştırma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de sözün zihindeki varlığıyla ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel gizleme ve saklama eylemidir; bu dal özel olarak söz veya anlamın dışa vurulmamış aşamasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişinin içinde bulunan sözü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi göğüste veya sırda gizleme anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de içte saklı olan şey alanında buluşur.

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, dışa vurulmadan önce zihinde tasarlanan söz anlamını verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düşünce çizgisine inanma veya bağlı olma anlamındaki kalıp için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Görüşe inanma ve benimseme çekirdeğini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir görüşe, mezhebe veya düşünce çizgisine inanıp onu benimsemek anlamındaki kalıp kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir görüş veya inancı benimsemektir.
Kullanım söz söylemeyi değil, kişinin bağlı olduğu düşünce veya mezhebi bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin belli bir düşünceye bağlılığı anlatıldığında doğal çeviridir.

error_profile.preserves: Benimseme ve bağlı görüş anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal görüş benimseme kalıbıdır; salt telaffuz veya iç düşünce değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme kalıbını bir görüşe veya mezhebe inanma ve onu benimseme anlamında açıklar. Bu, sadece sözlü ifade veya içte kalmış söz değil, bağlı olunan düşünce veya inanç yönelimidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım yalnız görüş veya mezhep benimseme kalıbına bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular görüş, mezhep, inanç, iç söz ve topluluk adı açısından tarandı; benimseme çekirdeğini ayıranlar yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu iç bağlılığın genel adıdır; bu dal söz kalıbının görüşe bağlılık anlamıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal söyleme kalıbıyla bir görüş veya mezhebi benimsemektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kalbin bir şeye bağlanması ve inanç veya görüşün sağlamlaşmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de zihinsel bağlılık ve inanç alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kişinin bağlılık eylemidir; komşu dal bağlı olunan sistem veya yolun adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişinin bir görüşü benimsediğini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal din, yol veya izlenen topluluk düzeni anlamındaki daha nesnel sistemi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de inanç ve izlenen yol alanına girebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda bağlı olunan görüş belirleyicidir; komşu dalda yalnız dışa vurulmamış söz veya anlam vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir görüşe inanma veya onu benimsemedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal söylenmemiş iç sözdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de iç zihinsel alanla ilişkilidir.

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, bir görüşe veya mezhebe inanma anlamındaki kalıp kullanımını verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözsüz bir nesne veya durumun anlam bildirdiği bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözsüz belirtme ve gösterme çekirdeğini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir durumun veya nesnenin söz söylemeden bir anlamı belli etmesi, sanki konuşuyormuş gibi işaret vermesi anlamındaki kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözsüz durumun bir şeyi belli etmesidir.
Bir kabın doluluğunun artık yeter anlamını belli etmesi bu tür kullanıma örnektir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözsüz durumun mecazi biçimde konuşur gibi anlatıldığı örnekte uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözsüz belirtmeyi konuşur gibi anlatma biçimini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sözsüz belirtmedir; insanın sesli konuşması veya içe doğan anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi cansız veya sözsüz bir durumun bir şeyi belli etmesini söyleme diye adlandırır. Çerçeve bunu konuşan insanın sözü değil, durumun gösterdiği anlam olarak doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım, durumun sözsüz belirtmesi örneğine bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular işaret, belirti, sözsüz gösterme, yalan söz ve kök içi sesli söyleme açısından tarandı; gösterme sınırları yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu delil ve gösterge alanını genişçe kapsar; bu dal belirli söz kalıbıyla durumun anlam bildirmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal verilen kalıpta durumun sözsüz anlam bildirmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: durumuyla belli etme / konuşur gibi gösterme

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir şeye samimi ilgi ve önem göstermektir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çekirdeği ve ona bağlı bildirme yönünü birlikte verir; daha dar söz dizimleri ayrıca açıklanmalıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçekleşme, bulunma ve olmayı bildirme yönlerini birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin var ya da gerçekleşmiş olduğunu bildiren akıcı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.adds: Günlük Türkçede durum bildiren daha geniş kullanımları da çağırabilir.
error_profile.preserves: Olma ve gerçekleşme çekirdeğini doğal Türkçe içinde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin ortaya çıkması veya sonradan olması vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Hazır bulunma ve dilbilgisel bildirme yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Sonradan olma ve meydana çıkma yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün asıl yükünü taşımayıp anlatımı güçlendiren bağlı kullanım için açıklayıcıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Pekiştirme görevini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gelmesi beklenen kişiyi belirli bir ad dışında tutan bağlı söz dizimi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayırma ve dışarıda tutma görevini korur.

error_profile.adds: Ayrı yer ve konum dalının kapsamını getirir.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün yer dalıyla karışır.
error_profile.loses: Gerçekleşme, olma bildirimi ve bağlı dil kullanımlarını siler.
error_profile.preserves: Bulunma çevresine zayıf bir yakınlık taşır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçekleşme ve bulunma çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; yer, konum, üstlenme ve boyun eğme ayrı dallardır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gerçekleşip ortaya çıkmak veya hazır bulunmak
birini geliş kapsamı dışında tutan bağlı söz

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle yokluktan sonra yeni duruma gelmeyi öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir şeyin sonradan gerçekleşmesi veya var hale gelmesi alanında buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal olma ve bulunur hale gelme çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gelme, varma ve bir yere ya da işe yönelme hareketini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gerçekleşen veya elde edilen bir durumdan söz edildiğinde yakınlaşırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal zaman içinde olma, gerçekleşme ve bildirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yer, bulunulan nokta ve kişinin konum değeriyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de aynı kökün olma ve bulunma çevresinden beslenir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal gerçekleşme ve olma bildirimi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişi adına sorumluluk üstlenmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi aynı kök ailesinde anılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulunulan nokta çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başkası yanındaki yeri veya düzeyi anlatıldığında uygundur.

text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًۭا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

baseline.text: Elçilerimiz Lût'a gelince onlar yüzünden kaygılandı ve çok sıkıştı. Elçiler, "Korkma, üzülme. Biz seni ve aileni kurtaracağız; geride kalacak olan karın hariç" dediler.

findings.text: Lût'un sıkışması, yalnız duygu değil, misafirlerini korumaya yetecek hareket alanı ve erişim kalmadığına dair bedensel bir kapasite ölçümüdür.
Korkmama sözü gelecek tehlikeyi kurtuluşla giderirken, üzülmeme sözü aile içindeki kaybı gerçek dışı saymaz; güvence iki ayrı acıya ayrı karşılık verir.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and occurrence supply the entry event that begins the pressure sequence.
Message-bearers supply agents whose role is not yet legible to Lot at arrival.
What causes gloom or distress marks the arrivals as an apparent liability.
Constriction of the breast supplies the felt overload produced by that apparent liability.

changed_reading.after: Their arrival is first experienced as a new burden that Lot believes his protective capacity cannot absorb.
changed_reading.before: The messengers arrive and Lot simply feels bad about the situation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated بهم first makes the arrivals the object of distress and constriction: their coming is registered as an incoming protective burden before they disclose what they can do.

activation_trace.role: Narrowness against breadth makes the clause a loss of usable room.
The extended arm supplies an embodied radius for attempted protection.
Measurement by the arm turns that radius into a visibly finite span.
Capacity and range make the measured span an operational limit that has been exceeded.

changed_reading.after: The idiom stages emotion as an embodied failure of reach: Lot cannot see how his own arm, measure, or power can cover those who arrived.
changed_reading.before: ضاق بهم ذرعا is only an idiom for intense emotion.

baseline_models.mechanism: Narrowness, arm, measurement, and capacity converge: distress is spatialized as a protective radius whose measure is too short for the demand placed upon it.

activation_trace.role: Audible speech makes reassurance an intervention delivered into the constricted scene.
Fear as expectation of harm supplies the forward-looking affect being checked.
Grief as inner roughness supplies a distinct affective burden rather than a synonym for fear.
Release by separation gives the speech an executable basis for its affective commands.

changed_reading.after: The speech regulates two horizons of distress by naming the extraction that changes the future while still leaving an explicit loss inside the promise.
changed_reading.before: Do not fear and do not grieve is a doubled formula of comfort.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا لا تخف ولا تحزن إنا منجوك
baseline_models.mechanism: Spoken reassurance separates anticipatory fear from grief's inner roughness and answers both with a concrete act of separation from danger, not with an abstract request to feel calm.

activation_trace.role: Separation from danger supplies the operation by which the rescued set is formed.
The group of proximity and belonging supplies the initial household set.
The explicit woman or wife term makes the exception cut through a normally intimate bond.
Situated being in time presents her contrasting status as already operative.
Remaining after others pass places her in a second collectivity opposed to the extracted household.

changed_reading.after: The sentence performs a boundary judgment: domestic proximity does not by itself determine membership in the group that departs.
changed_reading.before: The family is saved, with the wife added as an isolated exception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: منجوك وأهلك إلا امرأتك كانت من الغابرين
baseline_models.mechanism: The rescue declaration constructs a set and then cuts through its ordinary domestic boundary: spousehood names inclusion in one relation, while the exception and predicate assign the wife to the collectivity that remains.

activation_trace.role: The focus arrival is the event Lot initially reads through distress.
Distress supplies the initial negative valuation that the sequence reverses.
Aid and vindication supply Lot's immediately preceding request for intervention.
The matching arrival formula starts the disclosed answer before Lot recognizes it.
The same message-bearers connect the prior announcement to the focus arrival.
News that opens the face with joy gives the arrival a positive capacity alongside its destructive announcement.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the messengers' exact grasp of the population Lot cannot sort or secure.
The prior third-person rescue pledge reveals the function later spoken directly in the focus.

changed_reading.after: The very figures Lot experiences as the crisis are the already-dispatched form of the help he requested.
changed_reading.before: The visitors create a crisis and then happen to offer relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contiguous sequence turns the apparent burden into an unrecognized answer: Lot asks for help, the messengers arrive with a dual announcement, state exact knowledge of who is inside, and only then arrive to him and identify themselves as rescuers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contiguous request-arrival-plan encounter; I infer that the arrival functions as the answer before Lot recognizes it. A live alternative is that narrative succession need not itself assert a prayer-answer causal arrow.
structural_cues: 29:30 requests aid; 29:31-32 disclose the agents, plan, and rescue set; 29:33 presents Lot's delayed recognition of them.
The focus pivots from two occurrences of بهم as pressure to قالوا as the pressure's speaking subject.

activation_trace.role: Constricted capacity supplies Lot's experienced inability to absorb the demand.
Finite range and capacity provide the personal limit from which responsibility must move.
The messengers' promised separation from danger supplies the effective assumption of agency.
Carrying as surety supplies the surah's explicit failed promise to take responsibility for others.
Literal carrying supplies a later image of creatures unable to carry their own provision and therefore dependent on another agency.

changed_reading.after: His measured inability is the handoff point at which credible agents assume the protective burden that his own reach cannot carry.
changed_reading.before: Lot is overwhelmed and then receives a promise of safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-surah carrying language distinguishes failed human surety and creaturely non-self-sufficiency from the messengers' effective rescue pledge. Lot's shortened arm is therefore followed by a transfer of responsibility to agents who can actually bear it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carrying failures, Lot's narrowed capacity, and the messengers' active pledge; I infer a transfer from inadequate personal surety to effective rescue agency. A live alternative is that حمل and ذرع remain parallel capacity images without a designed transfer.
structural_cues: 29:12 denies the credibility of a human offer to carry another's liabilities, while 29:33 places an effective first-person plural rescue pledge after Lot's capacity fails.
29:60 repeats non-carrying immediately before assigning provision to God.

activation_trace.role: Narrowness supplies the closed spatial condition experienced in the focus.
Stride, effort, and traversing distance turn the arm image toward blocked mobility as well as emotion.
Release by separation supplies movement out of the closed field.
Road-cutting by seizure or obstruction supplies the local mechanism that makes passage unsafe.
A traversable extended road identifies what the community has severed.
Breadth opposed to constriction supplies the later spatial countercondition to Lot's narrowness.
The surah's closing paths restore traversability at the far end of the blocked-road pattern.

changed_reading.after: Rescue is route work: it removes the household from a social space whose paths and protective reach have been closed.
changed_reading.before: Rescue means protection from a threat at the same location.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offense immediately before the encounter includes severing the traversable road. Narrowed reach and rescue can therefore operate as route conditions: the social field has closed passage, and deliverance reopens movement into a wider domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut road, the focus's constricted range, rescue, later breadth, and paths; I infer that extraction restores traversability. A live alternative is that the later path language is ethical rather than spatial and only analogically sharpens the focus.
structural_cues: 29:29 places قطع السبيل directly before Lot's plea and the messenger sequence.
The later أرضي واسعة and سبلنا answer constriction with breadth and plural routes.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and belonging supply the household category that the promise initially names.
The wife term supplies domestic membership that does not settle rescue membership.
Remaining after others pass assigns the excepted wife to the nondeparting collective.
The same belonging root gathers the town's people into the collective marked for destruction.
The intervening rescue pledge narrows belonging from the town's people to Lot's people.
The return to the town's أهل supplies the collective from which the rescued household must separate.
House and household belonging supply a later social shell whose mere form offers no guaranteed protection.
Weakness of force makes the dwelling shell an unreliable basis for security.

changed_reading.after: Several affiliations overlap inside the town, and the utterance actively redraws the household as the subset that will leave rather than everyone who shares domestic proximity.
changed_reading.before: A natural household remains intact except for one anomalous spouse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding verses alternate أهل as the population of the town and as Lot's intimate group. The wife's exception marks overlapping memberships, while the later weak-house image prevents dwelling or household form from functioning as an automatic shelter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating scales of أهل, the exception, and a later weak house; I infer that trajectory and allegiance override co-residence when the rescue set is drawn. A live alternative is that the repeated أهل usages are locally distinct and the wife is simply an exception without a broader membership model.
structural_cues: 29:31 names أهل هذه القرية, 29:32 names أهله, 29:33 repeats أهلك with an exception, and 29:34 returns to أهل هذه القرية.
The wife remains grammatically close as spouse but is predicated among a different plural group.

activation_trace.role: Release by separation supplies the focus promise's core operation.
Remaining after others pass supplies the stationary counterposition to extraction.
Separation from danger supplies rescue associated with the ship after the flood seizure.
Separation from danger supplies rescue out of the fire episode.
The preannounced separation fixes extraction as the plan before the direct focus speech.
Separation from danger supplies movement from the vessel's peril to land.

changed_reading.after: We will save you promises a boundary crossing: the household is extracted from the doomed field while the excepted wife remains within it.
changed_reading.before: We will save you means that Lot and his family will survive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated rescue episodes across the surah use separation at destructive boundaries: ship and flood, fire, doomed town, and vessel to land. In the focus, rescue thus implies removal from a medium of destruction, in exact contrast to the wife who remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated نجو events at explicit material boundaries; I infer a shared topology of crossing out rather than being shielded in place. A live alternative is that the root contributes general deliverance without requiring one spatial template.
structural_cues: The rescue occurrences are paired in their verses or immediate context with السفينة, النار, the doomed القرية, and البر.
29:32-34 contrast the group removed with punishment descending on the town's people.

activation_trace.role: A remainder left after companions pass supplies the wife's contrastive temporal position.
Being situated in time presents that remainder-status as already established.
Leaving an effect behind supplies the immediate aftermath counterpart to الغابرين.
Manifest visibility turns what remains from mere debris into a legible sign.
Later visible dwellings reinforce the surah's pattern of aftermath made apparent.

changed_reading.after: She is assigned to the nondeparting side that becomes the catastrophe's aftermath, while those extracted pass beyond it; this does not make her literally identical with the later sign.
changed_reading.before: The wife is merely one of the people left behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from a person classified among those remaining to a punishment that descends and an effect deliberately left visible. This activates الغابرين not only as nondeparting people but as the human side of an event that produces a remainder and after-sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remainder-language followed by a deliberately left visible sign; I infer an aftermath relation between the wife's assigned group and the event's residue. A live alternative is that الغابرين means only those who lag or remain and should not absorb the material-sign echo.
structural_cues: 29:33 ends with الغابرين; 29:34 names the descending punishment; 29:35 immediately says تركنا منها آية بينة.
29:38 again makes prior destruction apparent from dwellings.

remaining_uncertainties: Whether الغابرين should carry only ordinary remaining or also the immediate aftermath-residue echo.
Whether the carrying and path patterns are designed causal mechanisms or productive analogies activated by the focus idiom.
The civic-hospitality and mobile-sanctuary readings depend on explicitly contained, branch-distant associations.
strongest_changes: The arrival is retrospectively the answer to Lot's plea: the apparent burden is the rescue agency before it is recognized.
Lot's narrowed arm becomes a finite protective capacity whose responsibility is transferred to credible rescuers.
Alternating town and household uses of أهل turn the wife's exception into a judgment among overlapping affiliations.
Surah-wide نجو episodes make rescue an extraction across a destructive boundary, opposed to remaining in place.
The immediate تركنا منها آية sequence sharpens الغابرين toward aftermath and residue without forcing that secondary echo.
summary.what_was_special: The focus makes the same arrivals both the object of two بهم pressure phrases and the speaking subject of rescue, then refuses a frictionless happy ending by cutting the wife from the departing أهل.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the visitors whose reception creates the focus crisis.
Message-bearers supply the arriving persons toward whom protective responsibility is felt.
Finite reach supplies the host's inability to extend protection over the arrivals.
Hospitality to a guest from gathered food supplies an inverted civic function beneath the town label.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Lot's shortened arm exposes a civic anti-hospitality: the gathering called a town fails at receiving arrivals, forcing one host to bear an impossible collective duty.
changed_reading.before: The town is only the geographical backdrop to Lot's private distress over visitors.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the nonliteral hospitality branch of ق ر ي beneath the ordinary settlement sense of القرية. It remains anchored in the focus's arriving messengers and Lot's narrowed protective reach; downstream prose should present it only as a branch echo, not as the lexical meaning of القرية here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جاءت رسلنا لوطا ... وضاق بهم ذرعا

activation_trace.role: Expected harm supplies the affect that a protected boundary would normally quiet.
Release by separation makes protection mobile rather than fixed to the threatened place.
The belonging group supplies what moves together inside the proposed protective boundary.
A spatial sanctuary supplies the fixed enclosure against which the focus's moving rescue can be compared.
Swift snatching supplies the unsafe exterior condition surrounding protected space.
The region around a thing supplies the contrast between an interior refuge and exposed surroundings.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their assurance and extraction form a mobile sanctuary around the departing household while the surrounding civic space remains exposed.
changed_reading.before: The messengers merely tell one frightened household that it will escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a remote cross-domain activation: the focus never calls the rescued group a sanctuary. It remains validly anchored in لا تخف, منجوك, and أهلك and is triggered by the later contrast of a protected precinct with people snatched around it; downstream prose should say the rescue behaves like a mobile protected boundary, not that the verse names one.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Moral distress rendered as lost room to act.** ض ي ق B001 is narrowness against spaciousness and B002 is chest constriction and distress. The narrowed ذرع gives distress a bodily measure before the messengers remove fear and grief by announcing rescue. I infer that Lot perceives no available reach within which to protect his guests; constriction reads as collapsed action-space, and reassurance reopens that space by supplying an external rescue mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:56's declaration that God's earth is spacious is the clearest later correction to constricted reach. When local action-space closes, divinely supplied movement and rescue can reopen it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Distress is pictured as a reach constricted below the task.** Lexical evidence: `ضَاقَ`, root `ض ي ق`, `B002` (chest constriction and distress), and `ذَرْعًا`, root `ذ ر ع`, `B004` (capacity as one's reach). Structural cue: the messengers' arrival first produces harm/distress, then speech corrects fear and sadness by announcing rescue; `29:34` reveals the descending threat Lot could not control. Assigned role: reach measures perceived practical capacity; constriction says the situation exceeds it. Abductive move: the packet gives an idiomatic pair, and I infer a causal model in which limited reach produces affective compression until superior agency is disclosed. Reading change: Lot's distress becomes an embodied assessment of incapacity, not undifferentiated emotion.

2. **The reassurance addresses future and retained pain separately.** Lexical evidence: `تَخَف`, root `خ و ف`, `B001` (fearful anticipation of harm); `تَحْزَنْ`, root `ح ز ن`, `B001` (rough sadness in the self); `مُنَجُّوك`, root `ن ج و`, `B001` (deliverance by separation); and `ٱلْغَابِرِين`, root `غ ب ر`, `B001` (remaining residue). Structural cue: fear and sadness are coordinated but distinct, followed by rescue and the wife's exception. Assigned role: promised separation answers anticipated danger, while the named residue explains a ground for sadness that rescue does not erase. Abductive move: the text does not assign each emotion an object; I infer the future/past-relational division from branch scope and sequence. Reading change: reassurance is differentiated: safety is promised without pretending that relational loss is unreal.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later correction (`29:56`):** “My earth is spacious” directly reverses the constricted reach of `ضَاقَ ... ذَرْعًا`. Lot's limited capacity was real but not total reality; later divine spaciousness shows that rescue can open actionable room beyond the distressed agent's measured reach.

Its rare l-m-m surface is grammaticalized here into temporal force, so any gathering or repair imagery stays subordinate to the when/as-soon-as function; the payoff is the immediate movement from arrival to distress, sharpened by the following {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}).

The feminine singular verb agrees with the broken-plural delegation as one arriving subject, while the accusative object keeps the arrival personal. The same messenger-arrival template recalls the earlier scene with Abraham (29:31), but here the formula moves from good news to crisis.

words.gloss_range: Our messengers as a possessed plural delegation and subject of arrival
words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلُنَا}} ({{tr:rusulunā}}) identifies the visitors as the speaker's commissioned messengers, not neutral guests. Variant {{ar:رُسْلُنَا}} ({{tr:ruslunā}}) lightens the sound without changing that commissioned identity. words.prose: {{ar:أَهْلَكَ}} ({{tr:ahlaka}}) is inside the rescue object before the exception: Lot's household shares the grammatical rescue status of the addressed you. The accompaniment reading foregrounds the family as saved together with Lot, while the singular collective form gathers an affiliated group under one second-person suffix. The familiar Lot formula pairs household inclusion with the wife exception (11:81, 15:60). Nearby ahl language also contrasts saved household with the doomed people of the town (29:34).

words.prose: {{ar:ٱمْرَأَتَكَ}} ({{tr:imraʾataka}}) names the spouse inside the household field and marks her accusatively as the excepted noun. The feminine singular form plus second-person suffix makes the exclusion both personal and relational. The recurring Lot-wife motif is explicit across the cited passages (7:83, 11:81, 15:60, 26:171, 27:57, 29:33, 66:10), and the phrase repeats the previous ayah's verdict with the pronoun shifted from his wife to your wife (29:32). The proposed virtue-lack inference from murūʾa is not locally licensed.

words.gloss_range: past feminine copula classifying the wife as already among the remaining-behind
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَتْ}} ({{tr:kānat}}) classifies the wife rather than narrating a new outcome. Its feminine singular agreement keeps her as the subject, and the past copula presents membership among the remaining-behind as already established. The simple k-w-n form marks state/classification, not a process of being made into that state, and the same verdict construction appears in another Lot-wife passage (27:57).

words.gloss_range: definite active participle plural naming the remaining-behind class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ghābirīn}}) is the governed final category: the definite active participle plural names the recognized class of those remaining behind. The active participle turns remaining into a stable identity at the ayah's close, while the gh-b-r field lets the verdict carry the shadow of being left as residue or passing away; those images are real color, but the local sense remains the remaining-behind class. The form is tightly concentrated in Lot-wife contexts and repeats the previous ayah's verdict (29:32), giving the final word heavy lexical and narrative weight.
